source: Zeliard (Game Arts 1987 / Sierra 1990), DOS MDT files
coordinates: Tile units. Cavern maps are 64 rows high and wrap in both directions (x mod width, y mod 64; door frames near the bottom wrap to row 0). Town maps are 8 rows high. Door "toX" for a cavern destination is the hero left column; "toHeadRow" is the hero head row. Town x is the hero absolute x (proximity_map_left_col_x + hero_x_in_viewport + 4, town.asm:2259).

maps.name: Felishika's Castle
maps.note: Castle is grouped with area 1 (it only connects to Muralla).

edges.note: Not a door. mp90 has is_jashiin_cavern set; Cavern_Game_Init waits for the flag to clear, then loads MDT 30 (MPA0) with the hero at proximity col 41 (fight.asm:284-303).
